name: Update 32
goals: Remove W/B marks from special-chicken art (#211)
Reduce Extra Bonus, WILD, and Deeper-trigger lag (#231): begin with a performance trace and evidence; reduce measured lag without speculative architecture.
After a first-spin Deeper hit, ease into a zoom that frames the whole wheel like a dartboard.
Live Watch (#199): opening chat during a live-view spin must not interrupt wheel/ball completion or cause console errors; do not duplicate the completed #181 keyboard-drawing fix.

Monster Room dice: regular dice stay white d12s; special/bonus dice retain type-specific colors and become d20s. Faces 13-20 generate more Monster cans through the existing can/tank flow, not a separate prize table. Before implementation, require a Banter notice, money PR linked to that notice, fast-sim/payback evidence, and an independent review.
cutLine: Austin temporary free-spin rule ends at 2026-10-24T14:00:00Z, the instant for Saturday 2026-10-24 15:00 Europe/Dublin: spins are free, wins go to Austin's wallet, and bets do not contribute to the jackpot; afterward normal play resumes. No live account or jackpot changes in this tracker update.
